title: Endpoint estimates for commutators of singular integral operators associated with admissible functions
summary: Let $(\mathcal X, d, μ)$ be a space of homogeneous type and let $ρ$ be an admissible function on $\mathcal X$. In this paper, we introduce a new class of singular integral operators associated with $ρ$, including a wide range of operators arising in harmonic analysis. For such an operator $T$ and a function $b$ belonging to suitable localized $\mathrm{BMO}$ spaces associated with $ρ$, which are strictly larger than the classical space $\mathrm{BMO}(\mathcal X)$, we establish the boundedness of the commutator $[b, T]$ from the Hardy space $H^1_ρ(\mathcal X)$ into $L^{1,\infty}(\mathcal X)$,…
